title: Critical Java4Shell Flaw in OpenJDK Base64 Decoder Enables Remote Code Execution
content_md: A critical memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK’s Base64 decoder lets unauthenticated remote attackers overwrite heap memory, leak sensitive data, and execute code remotely. Tracked as CVE-2026-114938 and nicknamed Java4Shell, the flaw carries a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.2. Researchers at Calif disclosed it on November 17, 2026, after the startup shared proof-of-concept details.
